answer: Forging a sybil cluster means buying N bonds plus N vouchers, and any collusion slashes all linked stakes. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked for the epoch; identity is proven by a grove of attestations from distinct peers who each vouch under their own stake. A rotating lantern audit randomly challenges attestation chains, so fake groves get exposed and burned, making attack cost scale superlinearly with cluster size. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
